ImageDescription.value:
A video, realisateur-bouba-kams from Cote D'Ivoire for Wiki Loves Africa 2024. This video focuses on the entrepreneurial journey of Ms. Marie Chantal Kouassi, founder and director of the company macKen Concept, during the construction process of the headquaters of Genesis Holding Company, from land acquisition to construction and finishing of the building. Genesis Holding Company is an ivorian company specialized in financial intermediation; the provision of technical studies, market studies, business plans, etc.; business development, particularly through direct financing, equity participation, joint ventures, etc.; and lobbying with private and public, national or international organizations.
As for macKen Concept, the company is a real estate company for the construction of buildings, offices and housing. The company is located in Abidjan, Cocody Synacassi 2 (Ivory Coast). It also offers the development and renovation of buildings and spaces (interior design and decoration and other green spaces, etc.). macKen Concept is an SARL created and managed by Mrs. Marie Chantal Kouassi, an Ivorian entrepreneur.
